purpose: Support explicit economic numerator/share-basis and cash-flow definition distinctions; no production method or legal policy adoption

sources.title: IFRS Foundation — IAS 33 Earnings per Share overview
sources.supporting_section: About, paragraphs describing EPS numerator/weighted denominator, basic/diluted presentation and denominator effects
sources.paraphrase: EPS has an earnings numerator and period-weighted share denominator. Basic/diluted basis and share transactions affect comparability. This supports explicitly binding numerator, claim and share basis rather than treating every per-share quantity as equivalent.
sources.scope_caveat: Accounting methodology context; not proof of any issuer input, actual QGV method authority or past data availability

sources.title: SEC Corporation Finance — Non-GAAP Financial Measures interpretations
sources.supporting_section: Questions 102.05 and 102.07; page last update December 13, 2022
sources.paraphrase: The guidance distinguishes per-share performance measures from cash-generation liquidity measures and notes that free cash flow lacks a uniform definition. This supports distinct economic measurement identity and an explicit description of cash-flow construction.
sources.scope_caveat: The filing-presentation rule is not declared to govern this personal diagnostic app; no legal determination, production restriction or automatic applicability policy is created
